units.source_text: 我深深感到，人是罪孽深重的。

en.t: I felt deeply that human beings are burdened with grave sin.

units.source_text: 这种负罪感驱使我每月都去为K扫墓，使我精心护理妻的母亲，并且命令我温柔地对待妻子。

en.t: This sense of guilt drove me to visit K's grave every month, made me care devotedly for my wife's mother, and commanded me to treat my wife gently.

units.source_text: 由于这种负罪感，我甚至恨不得让不相识的路人鞭挞我一顿。

en.t: Because of this guilt, I even wished that some stranger passing by would whip me.

units.source_text: 这样度日如年地苟活时，又觉得与其让别人鞭挞，应该自己鞭挞自己，

en.t: As I went on living in this miserable way, each day feeling like a year, I began to think that rather than be whipped by someone else, I ought to whip myself,

units.source_text: 进而又产生了与其自己鞭挞自己，还不如自己杀死自己的念头。

en.t: and then the thought arose that rather than whip myself, I would be better off killing myself.

units.source_text: 没有办法，我只好下决心让自己心如死灰地活下去。

en.t: Having no other way, I resolved to go on living as though my heart were dead ashes.

units.source_text: 我下了这样的决心，至今不知多少年了，我和妻子一直恩恩爱爱地生活到现在。

en.t: I do not know how many years have passed since I made that resolve, but my wife and I have lived affectionately together until now.

units.source_text: 我们绝不是不幸的一对，而是很幸福的。

en.t: We were by no means an unhappy couple; rather, we were very happy.

units.source_text: 但我内心的这一隐痛，这一重负，又似乎总是给妻子造成某种阴暗的感觉。

en.t: But this hidden pain in my heart, this heavy burden, seemed always to cast some kind of darkness over my wife.

units.source_text: 一想到这里，我就觉得很对不起妻子。

en.t: Whenever I think of this, I feel deeply sorry toward my wife.
